decisions.reason: The accepted one-click Sales Navigator-to-Apollo export is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message INTRODUCE Event; no additional MODIFY is needed.
Acceptance of the Apollo-mediated option does not necessarily remove, resume, or otherwise change the already deferred direct LinkedIn-to-HubSpot integration.
Selecting prospects from a Sales Navigator list uses the existing lead-list behavior but does not change its current configuration requirement.
The accepted transfer option does not state or necessarily change which type of LinkedIn profile URL is stored.
Automatic Apollo enrichment with email addresses is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message INTRODUCE Event.
Automatic transfer of enriched Apollo data to HubSpot, including the stated latency, is already fully represented by the candidate's same-message INTRODUCE Event.
The accepted lead-transfer path delivers data to HubSpot but does not change HubSpot lead-management properties, stages, lists, notes, or task assignment.
The source decision concerns initial prospect export, enrichment, and HubSpot transfer, not deferred silent-lead follow-up workflows or MeetAlfred campaign cleanup.
The accepted transfer option does not address synchronization or visibility of email and LinkedIn chat history in HubSpot.
The Apollo-to-HubSpot transfer option does not change the separately deferred HubSpot-to-MeetAlfred synchronization requirement.
Receiving enriched contacts in HubSpot does not change the selected HubSpot platform, subscription plan, or CRM use.
The source decision does not address the deferred MeetAlfred automated email campaign.
